talks.title: Workshop - Using AI to Simplify Azure Scripting and Management
talks.speaker: Aleksandar Nikolić
talks.abstract: Managing Azure often involves juggling PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bicep, and KQL queries, which can quickly become complex. This workshop shows you how tools like GitHub Copilot for Azure, Azure and ARM MCP Servers, and GitHub Copilot customization can help reduce that complexity. You'll see practical demos covering everything from generating scripts to troubleshooting deployments, all using natural language. We'll cover real-world scenarios such as automating tasks, building infrastructure as code, querying for inventory data, and fixing common issues. You'll leave with concrete ways to integrate these tools into your daily Azure work, making it faster and more reliable.

talks.title: Shadow AI: Congratulations, Your Confidential Data Is in Someone Else’s Chatbot
talks.speaker: Primož Bratanič
talks.abstract: Shadow AI is already inside the enterprise, whether IT approved it or not. Employees paste contracts, source code, credentials, incident data and internal conversations into chatbots, coding assistants and meeting bots with little visibility into where that data goes or who can access it later. This talk looks at how AI creates new exfiltration paths, how enterprise AI can magnify years of broken permissions and oversharing, and why “approved AI” is not automatically “safe AI.” Through practical examples, we will examine how quickly convenience defeats policy, DLP and common sense, and why organizations rushing to deploy AI may be creating a data-leakage problem they barely understand.

talks.title: Prihodnost nima tipkovnice: kako v Telekomu Slovenije soustvarjamo naslednjo generacijo glasovnih inteligentnih storitev
talks.speaker: Vid Čermelj, Nina Gljuk
talks.abstract: Glasovne storitve se po desetletjih razvoja ponovno postavljajo v središče digitalne izkušnje. Če so bile pretekle generacije telekomunikacij usmerjene predvsem v povezovanje ljudi, nastajajoča generacija storitev odpira prostor tudi za sodelovanje med ljudmi in umetno inteligenco. Na predavanju bomo preverili, kako Telekom Slovenije gradi temelje za prihodnost, v kateri bodo glasovni agenti postali naravni del govornih storitev. Predstavili bomo izkušnje z razvojem klepetalnih (chatboti) in glasovnih (voicebotov) robotov, izzive pri njihovem uvajanju v poslovne procese ter konkretne primere uporabe, od naprednega glasovnega usmerjanja klicev do avtomatizacije različnih delov uporabniške podpore. Pogledali bomo tudi korak dlje: kako bodo glasovni agenti postali sestavni del omrežja in zakaj prihodnost komunikacij morda ne temelji več na tipkovnici, temveč na pogovoru.

talks.title: Think Your Data Is Protected? Think Again.
talks.speaker: Omar Kudovic
talks.abstract: Most organizations believe their sensitive data is under control—until the first accidental leak, overshared document, or compliance incident proves otherwise. In this session, we'll take a practical, no-nonsense look at how Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) and Microsoft Data Loss Prevention (DLP) can help organizations classify, protect, and govern their most valuable asset: their data. This is not a marketing presentation. There are no flashy slides, no sales pitch, and no theoretical discussions. Instead, you'll see how these technologies work in the real world through 90% live demonstrations based on production environments, real customer implementations, and lessons learned from the field. Whether you're a Microsoft 365 Administrator, Security Engineer, Compliance Specialist, IT Professional, or Security Architect, you'll leave this session with practical knowledge, proven implementation strategies, and ideas you can apply immediately in your own environment. Less PowerPoint. More production. More demos. More real-world experience.

talks.title: Agent Skills in Practice: Governing a Product Backlog with GitHub Copilot
talks.speaker: Ana Roje Ivancic, Ognjen Bajic
talks.abstract: A vague backlog item is poor input for both agents and people. Now that agents act on your backlog, requirement quality matters even more. When backlog work remains manual, or teams use AI in disconnected chat contexts, they miss the real value of agentic workflows. We show how Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot and the Azure DevOps MCP Server turn backlog management into a governed, AI-assisted workflow: AI proposes and refines; people review and steer, and AI acts only upon approval. We’ll demo the flow from a spec to a hierarchical backlog with refined descriptions and test-ready acceptance criteria, all without manual editing. You'll learn how agent skills differ from prompt templates, how MCP changes what AI can do in Azure DevOps, and how approval gates keep people in control.

talks.title: Generating WebSharper source code generators
talks.speaker: Adam Granicz
talks.abstract: What if AI's most valuable contribution wasn't writing applications, but designing the languages used to describe them? This talk demonstrates how AI can generate WebSharper Source Code Generators that translate domain-specific languages into F#, leveraging WebSharper to produce complete, type-safe web applications. Rather than generating individual applications, AI generates reusable language translators that can produce entire families of web applications from domain-specific descriptions. We conclude by outlining a path towards constructing web applications directly from executable domain specifications.

talks.title: BYO disposable AI harness
talks.speaker: Ivan Čuljak
talks.abstract: We were taught to build to last, to build reusable stuff, to preserve, to standardize. Now think of scaffolding - it checks all the above boxes, but it allows you to assemble it differently on every single building. Now that producing source code, and thus assembling components, is cheap - why think of your most internal SDLC loop as something rock solid, if your development concept can be kept rock solid while the actual development loop can be adapted to a specific task? The same question goes for the AI harness - why keep struggling with a harness which keeps changing and which provides you with a zillion capabilities you do not actually need for a specific task? In this talk, I'll take you through the process of building disposable niche, but deterministic harnesses which leverage stochastic AI processes where they have to - as opposed to using stochastic AI harnesses and hoping they'll actually use the deterministic tools and gates you told them to.

talks.title: Kyborg: Agentično ogrodje za varnostne analitike v SOC
talks.speaker: Aljaž Kerlatec, Alex Ternav
talks.abstract: V predavanju bodo predstavili inovativno agentično ogrodje Kyborg, ki so ga razvili v podjetju KYBM. Ogrodje velike jezikovne modele spremeni v nadzorovano, zanesljivo orodje za varnostno-operativne centre (SOC) in varnostnim analitikom nudi podporo pri učinkovitejši obravnavi varnostnih incidentov. Incidente črpa iz različnih sistemov SIEM, prek protokola MCP pa ga je mogoče dinamično razširiti s poljubnimi zunanjimi orodji in viri. Z vgrajenim sistemom RAG jih obogati z relevantnim domenskim znanjem iz dokumentov organizacije, med razrešenimi incidenti pa poišče podobne pretekle primere in prenese že preverjene rešitve na nove, s čimer se čas obravnave občutno skrajša. Tako obogatene incidente analizira z uporabo javnih ali zasebnih velikih jezikovnih modelov ter analitikom pomaga hitreje razumeti dogodke in predlagati nadaljnje korake pri odzivu, s potrjevanjem občutljivih dejanj (human-in-the-loop) pa ogrodje omogoča tudi izvedbo različnih varnostnih akcij. Ponavljajoče se postopke lahko analitiki zajamejo v obliki ponovno uporabnih navodil (skills), ki jih agent samodejno poišče in uporabi pri podobnih primerih.

talks.title: kill -9 Your Agent: Durable AI Workflows with Microsoft Agent Framework
talks.speaker: Andrey Vykhodtsev
talks.abstract: Everyone loves showing an agent that works — but what about an agent that survives, and learns something along the way? In this session we will violently kill an AI agent mid-orchestration, repeatedly, and watch it resume exactly where it left off. An agent's state lives in three places — in the conversation, in the execution, and in the knowledge — and each survives something different. We will meet Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0, the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen, its Durable Task extension that adds durable execution to agent workflow graphs with automatic checkpointing, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop approvals that can wait for days without consuming compute, and managed memory in Foundry Agent Service, with which we coach the agent once on a working procedure it then applies on its own in future runs — including procedural memory, inspection of stored records, and the right to be forgotten. We will explain why checkpoint storage alone is not durability, and how the very same workflow definition runs locally, on Azure Functions, or in your own container with zero code changes. All demos run in Python and are grounded in lessons from production agent systems in the insurance industry; this talk is for engineers moving agents from demo stage to systems that must also work at three in the morning.

talks.title: Exchange Online Security Best Practices
talks.speaker: Scott Schnoll
talks.abstract: Microsoft Exchange remains a key target of attack by bad actors. Whether you are in the cloud, on-premises, or in a hybrid configuration, securing your Exchange environment is one of the most important things you can do. This session covers Microsoft's recommended best practices for securing Exchange Online environments, including zero trust, identity and access management, Defender, and more.

talks.title: Beyond the VPN: Secure Access to On-Premises Resources with Microsoft Entra
talks.speaker: Damir Dizdarevic
talks.abstract: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access represents Microsoft’s modern approach to securing access to applications and resources without relying on traditional VPN solutions. This session will explore how the platform can be used to provide secure access to on-premises resources by applying Zero Trust principles. The main focus will be on Microsoft Entra Private Access, its architecture, and the way it connects users to internal applications, servers, and services. Attendees will learn how access decisions can be based on user identity, device posture, location, risk level, and other contextual signals. The session will also highlight the key differences between Entra Private Access and conventional VPN technologies, including security, operational, and user-experience benefits. Practical implementation topics will include infrastructure planning, connector deployment, private resource publishing, and Conditional Access policy configuration. A live demonstration will show how users can securely access internal on-premises services from a remote location.

talks.title: Keep It Forever. Keep It Here. Keep It Secure. Good Luck.
talks.speaker: Primož Bratanič
talks.abstract: Slovenian IT gets interesting when the same data is simultaneously personal data, health data, archival material and part of a regulated information system. This talk explores the magical combination of ZVDAGA, ZAGOPP, ZInfV-1 and Article 23 of ZVOP-2: what must be preserved, where it may be stored, when its physical location must be known, which security and incident-reporting obligations apply, and what all of this means for modern cloud architectures. Using realistic public-sector and healthcare scenarios, we will follow a single piece of data through the regulatory maze and discover why “legal approved it”, “security approved it” and “the cloud vendor supports it” are three very different statements. And because this is 2026, we will finally ask the obvious question: what happens when somebody decides to feed all of it into AI?

talks.title: From Chaos to Fluency: Transforming our Engineers to be AI-Native
talks.speaker: Goran Brlas
talks.abstract: A few years ago, the term “AI adoption” meant a handful of enthusiastic engineers using one of the available chatbots, venting about the code it produced, and laughing at the notion that we would get to a point where AI could be so impactful in our line of work. Fast forward to today, and the story is quite different. AI is now ingrained in our way of working, and having a governed practice, with company-wide standards and tooling built into the workflow, isn’t a nice-to-have anymore. It’s table stakes. In this talk, I’ll cover how we approached our AI transformation: why it stalled when left to its own devices, what we tried and abandoned along the way, and what we’d tell ourselves if we were starting over today.

talks.title: A Nightmare on Cloud Street: Horror Stories from the Field
talks.speaker: Mustafa Toroman
talks.abstract: Cloud has many possibilities but also many traps. And believe us, we've seen it all. From huge bills, over wrong tools to security incidents... And any combination of it. Join us and see what the most common mistakes are and what to avoid on your journey to the Cloud.

talks.title: PowerShell with an Extremely Confident Intern
talks.speaker: Aleksandar Nikolić
talks.abstract: Writing PowerShell often means dealing with repetitive code, cryptic errors, documentation nobody wants to write, and tests everybody skips. AI tools can help, but only if you know what to ask, what to verify, and when the answer is confidently wrong. In this session, we'll use GitHub Copilot, MCP servers (which let AI tools query live systems such as Microsoft Graph rather than guessing), and other AI tools to tackle real PowerShell tasks, including refactoring scripts, generating documentation, hunting for bugs, and writing tests. We'll watch Copilot misdiagnose a script failure with complete confidence, then walk through how to catch that kind of mistake before it reaches production. This isn't a parade of perfect demos. You'll leave with a practical checklist for validating AI-generated PowerShell code, along with a better understanding of where these tools genuinely save time and where they quietly end up costing more than they save.

talks.title: Novosti v Microsoft 365 Copilotu - Od pomočnika do digitalnega sodelavca
talks.speaker: Sandi Jordan
talks.abstract: Microsoft 365 Copilot se razvija iz pametnega pomočnika v aktivnega digitalnega sodelavca, ki ne le odgovarja na vprašanja, temveč pomaga načrtovati, ustvarjati vsebine, analizirati podatke in izvajati poslovne procese. Na predavanju bomo predstavili najpomembnejše novosti zadnjega leta: nove agente v Microsoft 365, napredne zmogljivosti Copilot Chat, uporabo Work IQ za razumevanje poslovnega konteksta ter nove izkušnje v Wordu, Excelu, PowerPointu, Outlooku in Teamsu. S praktičnimi primeri bomo pokazali, kako lahko organizacije z uporabo Copilota in agentov povečajo produktivnost zaposlenih ter pospešijo digitalno transformacijo.

talks.title: Ko SharePoint ni več dovolj: pot do poslovne aplikacije s Power Platform
talks.speaker: Robert Kreslin
talks.abstract: V številnih organizacijah se digitalizacija poslovnih procesov začne z Excel preglednicami in SharePoint seznami, saj omogočajo hitro uvedbo rešitve z minimalnimi stroški in brez zahtevnega razvoja. Toda ko število uporabnikov, količina podatkov in poslovne zahteve začnejo naraščati, se organizacije pogosto znajdejo pred vprašanjem, kako obstoječo rešitev nadgraditi, ne da bi pri tem izgubile prednosti, ki jih prinaša platforma Microsoft 365. Na predavanju bomo skozi resničen primer iz prakse predstavili pot razvoja poslovne rešitve, ki se je začela s SharePoint seznamom, nato pa se postopoma razvila v celovito poslovno aplikacijo na platformi Microsoft Power Platform. Sprehodili se bomo skozi ključne odločitve, izzive in mejnike projekta ter pokazali, kako se potrebe uporabnikov skozi čas spreminjajo in zakaj rešitve, ki so bile na začetku popolnoma ustrezne, sčasoma pogosto dosežejo svoje omejitve. Predstavili bomo, kako smo izboljšali uporabniško izkušnjo z uporabo Power Apps, kako smo reševali izzive pri večjem številu zapisov ter kakšno vlogo ima Dataverse pri gradnji sodobnih poslovnih aplikacij. Dotaknili se bomo tudi povezovanja z zunanjimi sistemi, avtomatizacije procesov in integracij, ki poslovnim aplikacijam dodajo pravo vrednost ter jih iz enostavnih obrazcev spremenijo v pomemben del poslovnega informacijskega sistema. Predavanje ne bo osredotočeno zgolj na tehnologijo, temveč predvsem na izkušnje iz prakse, pridobljena znanja in odločitve, ki jih morajo sprejemati organizacije pri načrtovanju svoje digitalne poti. Udeleženci bodo dobili vpogled v to, kdaj je SharePoint še vedno odlična izbira, kdaj je smiselno razmisliti o uporabi Dataversa in Power Platform ter kako prepoznati trenutek, ko preprosta rešitev preraste v poslovno aplikacijo.

talks.title: Red vs Blue: AI Edition
talks.speaker: Miha Pihler, Milan Gabor
talks.abstract: Red vs Blue: AI Edition je praktično predavanje o uporabi umetne inteligence pri napadih in obrambi okolij Active Directory in Microsoft 365. Na strani Red Teama bomo prikazali, kako lahko AI pomaga pri analizi domenskega okolja, iskanju napačnih konfiguracij, načrtovanju poti do višjih privilegijev ter pri napadih na identitete in Microsoft 365. Na strani Blue Teama bomo pokazali, kako lahko AI pomaga pri analizi Windows in Microsoft 365 dogodkov, prepoznavanju sumljivega vedenja, korelaciji aktivnosti ter hitrejšem odzivu na incidente. Predavanje bo temeljilo na praktičnih demonstracijah in prikazalo, kako AI spreminja klasičen boj med napadalcem in branilcem v okoljih AD, Entra ID in Microsoft 365.

talks.title: BDD Reloaded: AI-Assisted Collaboration from Business Intent to Executable Tests
talks.speaker: Ognjen Bajic, Ana Roje Ivancic
talks.abstract: Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) is 20+ years old, yet most teams never try it; the rest reduce it to a testing format rather than business–development collaboration. The main challenges: refinement is slow, scenarios are hard to write, and automation is costly to maintain. With practice-tested agent skills, AI accelerates refinement, sharpens requirements into clear, complete acceptance criteria, expands scenarios, writes Gherkin and its automation code. In a live demo, we show how the business describes intent in natural, domain language while development turns it into living documentation and automated verification. We cover benefits, risks, and failure modes of AI-assisted BDD. Core message: BDD is finally easy enough for everyday work. AI removes the friction, not the conversation.

talks.title: Beyond Chat: Building Agentic Apps
talks.speaker: Denis Mušić
talks.abstract: What happens when AI is no longer just a chatbot but becomes an active part of our application? In this presentation, we will demonstrate how to build agents capable of using tools, calling APIs, collaborating with other agents, and executing specific tasks. The focus is on practical examples and real-world scenarios from .NET application development.

talks.title: Checkmate: Real Incidents That Can End a Software Company
talks.speaker: Jasmin Azemović
talks.abstract: Security failures rarely start with sophisticated zero-day exploits. In most cases, they begin with ordinary decisions: a rushed commit, a misconfigured cloud service, an overlooked alert, or a trust assumption that no longer holds. I’ve seen how real-world incidents unfold, not in theory, but in live production environments with customers, revenue, and reputations on the line. This talk breaks down five real incident scenarios that placed software companies in “checkmate” positions and is presented from the defender’s perspective, showing how technical failures, process gaps, and human factors intersect. We will examine how attacks moved through CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, identity systems, and third-party dependencies. This session is not about fear, compliance checklists, or abstract security theory. It is a practical, experience-driven look at how companies actually fail, and what developers, architects, and engineering leaders can do differently to avoid repeating the same mistakes. Attendees will leave with concrete lessons on design decisions, development practices, and security assumptions that silently determine whether an incident becomes a manageable disruption or a company-ending checkmate.

talks.title: What’s New in Windows Server 2025 for cloud-focused IT Pros
talks.speaker: Sander Berkouwer, Tomislav Fučkar
talks.abstract: Windows Server 2025 is Microsoft’s latest and greatest Windows Server operating system. Now that it is on the market for over a year, Tom and Sander have migrated over many organizations from previous versions of Windows Server to Windows Server 2025 in hybrid and cloud environments. They'll provide answers to your questions: What is Windows Server 2025’s place in cloud-focused environments where Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) rules the day? Does Windows Server play nicely with other Microsoft Cloud services like Azure, Entra and Microsoft 365? What are the out-of-the-box features that you can leverage or have to heed, and what role do the monthly cumulative updates have in all this? This is not a Windows Server 2025 marketing session. If you want to really know what Windows Server 2025 brings and has already brought in real-world scenarios, this is the session you’ll want to attend!

talks.title: SQL Server 2025 Optimized Locking
talks.speaker: Mladen Prajdić
talks.abstract: Introduced in SQL Server 2025, optimized locking improves transaction locking mechanism to reduce lock blocking and lock memory consumption for concurrent transactions. It's composed of two primary components: transaction ID (TID) locking and lock after qualification (LAQ). In this session, we'll look into how this works and how we can use it to improve our server's locking concurrency.

talks.title: Microsoft 365 Governance in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Age
talks.speaker: Slavko Kukrika
talks.abstract: Microsoft 365 Copilot increases productivity, but it also exposes flawed data governance. This session explores the paradigm shift where AI respects existing user permissions but instantly surfaces hidden, overshared data. Building upon a foundation of document classification, granular permissions, and robust access controls, session will shift focus into the mechanics of end-to-end data lifecycle management and data retention within Microsoft 365. We will explore how retention labels and retention policies control how long data resides inside Microsoft 365.

talks.title: Copilot v Excelu
talks.speaker: Gašper Kamenšek
talks.abstract: AI promises to change the world—and it is easy to believe that, with AI at our fingertips, we can change it too. In this session, we’ll put that promise to the test with Copilot in Excel. We’ll explore what it can really do, where it shines, where it falls short, and ultimately ask: how realistic is it to expect Copilot in Excel to change the way we work.

talks.title: Entra.News: kaj ste zamudili od zadnjega NT-ja
talks.speaker: Matej Klemenčič
talks.abstract: Ste prebrali vse Microsoftove bloge o Entra ID v zadnjem letu? Ne? Dobrodošli v večini. Nekateri so bili objavljeni z glasnimi fanfarami, drugi so tiho zdrsnili v produkcijo, ne da bi kdorkoli opazil. Skupaj bomo pregledali oboje: tisto, kar bi morali že vedeti in tisto, kar boste prvič slišali danes. Nekatere od teh sprememb so se namreč že zgodile v vašem okolju.

talks.title: Od RAG-a do agentov: kako zgraditi zaupanja vreden AI operacijski model
talks.speaker: Marko Kokol
talks.abstract: Podjetja so v zadnjih letih preizkušala generativno umetno inteligenco, RAG arhitekture in velike jezikovne modele, vendar se prava konkurenčna prednost začne šele takrat, ko AI postane del operacijskega modela organizacije. Naslednji korak niso samo boljši chatboti, ampak agentni sistemi, ki znajo uporabljati orodja, dostopati do znanja, preverjati vire, izvajati omejene korake v poslovnih procesih in pustiti sledljivo razlago svojih odločitev. V predavanju bomo pogledali, kako preiti od klasičnega RAG sistema do varnega agentnega RAG vzorca, kjer model ne odgovarja samo na vprašanja, temveč deluje znotraj jasno določenih pravil, dovoljenj, evalvacij in človeškega nadzora. Poseben poudarek bo na sveže veljavnem AI Act, slovenskem jeziku, domensko specifičnem znanju, varovanju podatkov, prompt-injection tveganjih, merjenju kakovosti in povezavi med AI arhitekturo ter poslovnimi KPI-ji. Demo bo prikazal majhno, a realno arhitekturo slovenskega domenskega agenta, ki dela z dokumenti, uporablja omejena orodja, beleži odločitve in omogoča preverjanje kakovosti odgovorov ter izvedenih korakov.

talks.title: Automating technical documentation in lab environments with Microsoft Copilot
talks.speaker: Vladimir Meloski, Ivanka Hadji-Petrusheva Meloska
talks.abstract: AI is changing how teams create and manage documentation, governance processes, and quality records. In highly regulated environments such as medical labs, key priorities include accuracy, consistency, traceability, and audit readiness. Microsoft Copilot can support common procedures in laboratories with their compliance with different ISO regulations. Tasks include creating and updating procedures, preparing incident reports and deviation reports, tracking performance indicators, and creating controlled documents. When used together with good quality-management practices—such as clear ownership, approvals, access control, audit trails, retention rules, and training records, Microsoft Copilot reduces the occurrence of manual errors and makes processes easier to repeat and verify. In this session, you will learn how Microsoft Copilot can help simplify documentation work, make reports more consistent, and keep records well controlled across complex lab systems. You will also learn how to keep information accurate, compliant, and traceable from creation to approval and long-term use.

talks.title: A real-world approach to transitioning Domain Controllers to Windows Server 2025
talks.speaker: Sander Berkouwer
talks.abstract: Windows Server 2025 is Microsoft's latest and greatest. As Domain Controllers, they scale further than ever and offer a new security baseline. ... but if your organization uses Domain Controllers with previous versions of Windows Server, the task to transition to Windows Server 2025 may feel insurmountable. There is significant history in your Active Directory, there are many challenges and you'll face obstacles you didn't envision at the start of the project. In this session, Sander Berkouwer and Tomislav Fučkar share their battle-tested transitioning method for Domain Controllers. Not only did they lead and perform transition projects, they are allowing everyone to benefit from their approach, their knowledge and their experience. When you walk away from this presentation, you'll have all the tools you need and feel confident enough to tackle the challenge of transitioning all your Domain Controllers to Windows Server 2025.

talks.title: How to build Agent in Microsoft Copilot without MS Copilot studio
talks.speaker: Nenad Trajkovski
talks.abstract: Copilot said: We’ve all heard about Copilot. And about agents. But what if you want to create your very own agent? Coding? Nooooo. And I’m not talking about Copilot Studio. I’m talking about creating an agent directly from Copilot itself — without writing a single line of code. And you can build such an agent in just 15 minutes. Come to this session and I’ll show you how. Then you’ll be able to create your own agents too!

talks.title: Požarni zid Windows - drugi del
talks.speaker: Miha Pihler
talks.abstract: V drugem delu predavanja si bomo ogledali napredne tehnike uporabe in upravljanja požarnega zidu Windows, med drugim: uporabo IPsec znotraj požarnega zidu za dodaten nadzor nad dostopi, ki so lahko vezani na uporabnika ali računalnik, upravljanje požarnega zidu s pomočjo rešitve Microsoft Intune, dodatne možnosti centraliziranega upravljanja s pomočjo oblaka. Predavanje temelji na več kot 10 letih praktičnih izkušenj z implementacijo in uporabo požarnega zidu Windows.

talks.title: The End of Manual Tasks: Automating Networks, Virtualization and Windows Environments with Ansible Automation Platform
talks.speaker: Simon Babič
talks.abstract: Most organizations still rely on individual scripts for automation, often understood only by the person who wrote them. Ansible Automation Platform offers a different approach: centralized, repeatable and controlled automation with clearly defined access rights and a complete audit trail of all executions. Through practical examples from a managed services environment, the session will demonstrate how to automate network device configuration backup and restore, virtual machine provisioning, server patch management, and Active Directory tasks. Special emphasis will be placed on real-world experience – where implementations most often run into challenges, which pitfalls are often left out of the documentation, and what we would do differently today.

talks.title: My Data is GOOD?
talks.speaker: Catalin Gheorghiu
talks.abstract: Common scenario: let’s do shortcuts soup, doing an ETL pipeline we could have GIGO. How to validate the data, for example in a Databricks based pipeline. What are the expectations (pun intended) that we can do? On this sweet session, Kinder chocolates sweet, we will explore what tools can use and when, and what are the benefits of using that specific tool. As a result would not be lost when you realize that you need data validation, and you need it just maybe you do not realize it.

talks.title: Revolucija žetonov
talks.speaker: Ivan Kovač
talks.abstract: Prvi je sledila druga, tretja, in prišla je četrta industrijska revolucija. Zagotovo pride peta, po nekaterih ocenah, je že. V četrti so fizični in digitalni sistemi konvergirali v kibernetske sisteme. Ključni a ne edini akterji so računalništvo v oblaku, veliki podatki in internet stvari. Prav prva dva sta omogočila tudi ponovni razcvet umetne inteligence. A ena stvar je ostala nespremenjena, poraba virov ustvarja strošek in račune. Operativni model FinOps Framework in specifikacija FOCUS pomagata porabo in strošek razumeti, razdeliti in optimizirati. Na podlagi razumevanja lahko količinsko ovrednotimo in določimo vrednost porabe. Povezava porabe s poslovno vrednostjo in pričakovanji nam omogoči pravočasno sprejemanje poslovnih odločitev. Kdo so torej ključni akterji in kaj je gorivo pete industrijske revolucije? Verjetno ne edina a agent in kontekst sta zagotovo ključna akterja. Kaj pa je gorivo? V moderni ekonomiji ima več vlog kot katerokoli drugo blago v moderni zgodovini. Je enota vrednosti s katero želijo podjetja ustvarjati dobičke. V resnici je komercialni izraz celotne ekonomije umetne inteligence. Podatek o ceni še ne pove, ali ustvarjamo poslovno vrednost. Kaj je torej žeton? In kaj imajo s tem FinOps Framework, FOCUS, ekonomija enote in finančna odgovornost posameznika? To so prava vprašanja.

talks.title: Ko zaupanje postane ranljivost: napad na sodobno Active Directory okolje
talks.speaker: Žan Urbančič, Danijela Šantak
talks.abstract: When Trust Becomes a Vulnerability: Attacking a Modern Active Directory Environment In modern Active Directory environments, an attacker does not always need a stolen password to take over a domain. Often, it is enough to understand how applications, service accounts, LDAP integrations, Kerberos authentication, delegation mechanisms, and credential storage systems are interconnected. In this technically in-depth presentation, we will demonstrate a realistic attack scenario that begins with a seemingly ordinary business application integrated with Active Directory. By exploiting an inadequately protected configuration and abusing the trust relationship between the application and the directory, the attacker obtains access to an initial service account. On its own, this account does not provide complete control of the environment, but it opens the door to the world of domain identities, Kerberos tickets, computer accounts, and delegation paths. Through a live demonstration, we will show how limited initial access can gradually evolve into more advanced abuse of Active Directory mechanisms. The presentation will cover service account abuse, Kerberos authentication without knowing passwords, temporary credentials, Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD), Kerberos Constrained Delegation (KCD), and manipulation of Service Principal Name (SPN) records. Particular emphasis will be placed on the fact that these mechanisms are legitimate components of Windows environments, yet when misconfigured, they can become powerful tools in the hands of an attacker. In the final part, we will demonstrate how a compromised server can also put seemingly securely stored secrets at risk, such as administrative credentials kept in local tools or password vaults. The presentation concludes with a complete domain takeover and an analysis of the key points at which an organization could have detected, contained, or prevented the attack. The main message of the presentation is clear: modern attacks against Active Directory are no longer just attacks on passwords. They are attacks on trust, configuration, and identity paths that organizations often fail to monitor closely enough.

talks.title: Power Platform administracija in governance: kako omogočiti inovacije brez izgube nadzora
talks.speaker: Rajko Lah
talks.abstract: Power Platform organizacijam omogoča hitro digitalizacijo procesov, avtomatizacijo dela in razvoj aplikacij brez klasičnega razvojnega cikla. Prav ta hitrost pa za IT odpira nova vprašanja: kdo lahko ustvarja aplikacije, kateri konektorji so dovoljeni, kako zaščititi podatke, kako upravljati okolja in kako preprečiti nenadzorovano širjenje rešitev. Na predavanju bomo pogledali, kako vzpostaviti učinkovit governance model za Power Platform. Osredotočili se bomo na administracijo okolij, DLP politike, varnostne vloge, upravljanje konektorjev, spremljanje uporabe, življenjski cikel aplikacij in tokov ter uporabo Center of Excellence pristopa. Cilj ni zavirati uporabnikov, temveč jim dati varne okvirje, v katerih lahko gradijo uporabne rešitve.

talks.title: Microsoft Entra ID: A Year of Updates in One Session
talks.speaker: Slavko Kukrika
talks.abstract: Microsoft Entra ID is the foundational directory service used by Microsoft 365 and Azure. In this session, we will explore the updates added to the Microsoft Entra ID platform over the past year. Among other features, we will introduce and demonstrate: Backup and Recovery: A feature that automatically captures snapshots of identities and configurations, allowing you to quickly revert them to a "known good" state. Account Recovery: A capability powered by Verified ID that uses face recognition to enable users to regain access to their accounts even after losing all registered authentication methods. Tenant Governance: A solution providing centralized discovery, monitoring, and management across multiple Microsoft tenants. We will also cover updates to conditional access policies, roles, and other security improvements.

talks.title: From Documents to Intelligence: The Future of SharePoint with AI
talks.speaker: Robi Vončina
talks.abstract: SharePoint is no longer just a document repository. Discover how Microsoft is transforming SharePoint into an AI-powered knowledge platform with Copilot, Knowledge Agents, and SharePoint Premium. Learn how organizations can leverage AI to extract knowledge from content, automate business processes, and enable employees to find answers instead of files. Join us for a practical and inspiring look at the future of information management in Microsoft 365.

talks.title: Kaj počne naprava, ko ne gledamo? Od analize komunikacije do skrivnosti v firmwareu
talks.speaker: David Kavčnik
talks.abstract: Kaj v resnici počne omrežna naprava, ko je nihče ne opazuje? Na primeru cenovno dostopne omrežne oziroma IoT-naprave bomo prikazali praktičen postopek varnostne analize – od prvih sumljivih povezav proti oddaljenim strežnikom do pridobivanja in analize firmwarea. Spremljali bomo omrežni promet, identificirali zunanje storitve, razstavili firmware ter pregledali datotečni sistem, konfiguracijo in ključne programske komponente. Iskali bomo vgrajene ključe, poverilnice, skrite diagnostične funkcije, nevarne protokole in druge mehanizme, ki lahko proizvajalcu ali napadalcu omogočijo dostop do naprave. Predavanje bo temeljilo na resnični analizi naprave in praktičnih demonstracijah. Poleg konkretnih ugotovitev bo predstavljen tudi ponovljiv pristop, s katerim lahko preverimo, kaj se dejansko skriva v napravah, ki jim vsakodnevno zaupamo dostop do svojih omrežij.

talks.title: AI-assisted OWASP ASVS compliance process
talks.speaker: Goran Šiška
talks.abstract: The talk covers the complete workflow, from interpreting ASVS requirements to validating implementations, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of AI-assisted security reviews and the role of human expertise in the process.

talks.title: Bring Your Own Agent: LangGraph in Production on Foundry Agent Service
talks.speaker: Andrey Vykhodtsev
talks.abstract: Foundry Agent Service reached general availability in July 2026, and the best part of the story is that you do not have to rewrite your agent for it. In this session we take an existing agent written in LangGraph and host it as a Foundry hosted agent without touching its logic: every session runs in its own VM-isolated sandbox, and the agent automatically receives its own Entra identity, a dedicated endpoint, a persistent home directory, and OpenTelemetry tracing. Then we go where the marketing ends: through the full azd lifecycle from init to deploy, through generating and running evaluations, to the agent optimizer, which proposes improvements as ranked candidates with a complete audit trail and one-command rollback. Along the way we tick off the practical traps: immutable versions with no traffic splitting, sandbox size ceilings, billing by active sessions, private container registry rules, choosing between the Responses and Invocations protocols, and how all of this compares to Container Apps and AKS. The talk is grounded in a real architecture decision from a production project and is aimed at everyone moving agents from prototypes into governed, managed production on Azure.

talks.title: What does data science look like now that everyone has access to an LLM?
talks.speaker: Tomaž Kaštrun
talks.abstract: LLMs and Generative AI have changed the way we think about data science. But how much have they really changed the work of a data scientist? In this session we will look at a changes, what have stayed the same, and where traditional machine learning still fits in a increasingly dominated foundation models and AI tools in Microsoft Azure. In this session, we will explore what data looks like in Azure in the age of LLMs and GenAI. What has fundamentally changed? What remains the same and when should we use LLMS versus traditional learning and data science techniques. Through practical demos, we will explore how the data science workflow is evolving - from tools and programming languages to user experience, interacting with Azure portal and day-to-day development. And explore where LLMs can genuinely help us with smarter, faster, and more effective delivery.

talks.title: SharePoint permissions management with Power Automate
talks.speaker: Klemen Vončina
talks.abstract: When you start breaking SharePoint permissions inheritance, keeping track of who has access to what can become tricky. In this session, we will look at how we can use Power Automate to create permission reports, add and remove permissions, and even use some tricks to allow users to work with items without giving them permissions.

talks.title: Intune - what is new
talks.speaker: Jan Bočko Kuhar
talks.abstract: The biggest new Intune capabilities over the past year center on AI‑powered automation, deeper cross‑platform device control, stronger security workflows, and major improvements to update orchestration.

talks.title: Rdeča ekipa ne spi več
talks.speaker: Milan Gabor
talks.abstract: Umetna inteligenca spreminja ofenzivno kibernetsko varnost iz dejavnosti, omejene s človeškim tempom, v neprekinjeno delovanje s hitrostjo strojev. Na predavanju bomo raziskali vzpon avtonomnih agentov umetne inteligence, ki so sposobni napadati domene Windows, aplikacije in informacijsko infrastrukturo. Spoznali bomo »abliterirane« modele – odprte modele, ki so bili spremenjeni tako, da so njihove varnostne zavrnitve odstranjene ali bistveno oslabljene. Pokazali bomo, zakaj so zaradi nizkih stroškov in možnosti lokalnega izvajanja dostopni, zasebni ter jih je težko nadzorovati. V nasprotju s tradicionalno avtomatizacijo lahko ti agenti analizirajo neznana okolja, uporabljajo orodja, pridobivajo ponovno uporabne veščine, se prilagajajo ob neuspehu in nadaljujejo delo brez stalnega človeškega usmerjanja. Skozi nadzorovane demonstracije v izoliranem laboratorijskem okolju bomo spremljali agente pri analizi sistemov, odkrivanju napadalnih poti ter poskusih kompromitacije simulirane domene Windows in ranljivih aplikacij. V zaključku bomo predstavili, kaj ta premik pomeni za branilce. Če lahko napadalci delujejo neprekinjeno in s hitrostjo strojev, morajo varnostne ekipe na novo premisliti zaščito identitet, segmentacijo omrežij, nadzor, upravljanje napadalnih poti in odzivanje na incidente. Hkrati morajo začeti uporabljati obrambno avtomatizacijo, ki bo sposobna slediti hitrosti novih groženj. Rdeči ekipi ni več treba spati. Je vaša obramba pripravljena?

talks.title: Copilot Cowork: From Answering Questions to Doing the Work
talks.speaker: Sead Borovina
talks.abstract: New kid on the block (relatively new) - Copilot Cowork - does the work and hands you the finished artefact. In this session we position Cowork against Chat and traditional agents, explain what it is then break down what makes it tick: Skills, Plugins, Work IQ, and the usage-based billing gate that must be switched on before anyone in your tenant sees it at all. We go deeper on extending Cowork: authoring your own skills as simple SKILL.md instructions to encode your team's standards and bundling them with connectors as plugins to reach the systems where your data actually lives, with tips and tricks from the field.

talks.title: DAMA Slovenija: Zakaj je Data Management v dobi AI še pomembnejši
talks.speaker: Mitja Hafner
talks.abstract: DAMA izhaja iz preprostega načela: podatki so strateško sredstvo organizacije in jih je treba sistematično upravljati. Z razvojem AI to postaja še pomembnejše. V okviru predavanja bomo najprej predstavili DAMA International – globalno, neprofitno in vendor-neodvisno strokovno združenje na področju Data Managementa – ter letos ustanovljeno DAMA Slovenija, slovenski chapter, katerega namen je povezovanje podatkovnih strokovnjakov, izmenjava znanja in dobrih praks ter razvoj lokalne strokovne skupnosti. Nato bomo osvetlili nekaj ključnih vsebin in gradnikov, ki jih DAMA prinaša podatkovni stroki: DAMA-DMBOK® kot referenčni okvir dobrih praks, DAMA Wheel kot celovit pogled na področja Data Managementa ter CDMP® kot mednarodno certificiranje podatkovnih strokovnjakov. Dotaknili se bomo tudi razvoja DAMA-DMBOK® 3.0, s katerim DAMA sledi spremembam, ki jih prinašajo AI in nove oblike uporabe podatkov. Osrednji del predavanja bo namenjen vprašanju, zakaj Data Management in Data Governance v dobi AI postajata še pomembnejša. AI povečuje potrebo po jasnih definicijah in standardih, kakovosti podatkov, metapodatkih, lastništvu in odgovornostih, pri čemer ima Data Governance ključno povezovalno vlogo. AI ne zmanjšuje potrebe po upravljanju podatkov – ravno nasprotno. Bolj kot podatke uporabljamo za AI, pomembneje je, da jih razumemo, jim zaupamo in jih sistematično upravljamo.
